ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Non-Profit Fraud
ideas.description: Investigation into the financial transactions of non-profit organizations to identify potential fraudulent activities
ideas.angle: Data analysis of non-profit financial records
questions: What are the most common types of non-profit fraud?
How can non-profit organizations prevent fraudulent activities?
ideas.insight: This story idea has the potential to uncover widespread fraudulent activities in the non-profit sector. By analyzing financial records and identifying patterns of suspicious behavior, we can shed light on the issue and provide recommendations for prevention.
